name: Problem → Consequence → Practical Fix
description: State the problem, explain what goes wrong, then give a concrete, easy‑to‑apply tip.

name: Question → Recognition → Advice
description: Pose a rhetorical question or observation, let the reader recognize their own situation, then provide a short recommendation.

name: Common Mistake → Why It Matters → Better Approach
description: Identify a frequent error, explain its impact, and suggest a better way.

name: Observation → Explanation → Takeaway
description: Share an interesting fact or surprising observation, briefly explain it, and end with a concise lesson.

name: Scenario → Hidden Problem → Solution
description: Describe a realistic scenario, surface a hidden issue, then propose a simple solution.

name: Myth → Reality → Practical Implication
description: Debunk a common myth, present the real facts, and explain what the reader should do.

name: Before/After Situation → Explanation
description: Contrast a before‑state with an after‑state, then explain why the change matters.

name: Checklist → Explanation
description: Provide a short checklist of actions and briefly justify each point.

name: Unexpected Observation → Lesson
description: Present a surprising fact and draw a short business lesson from it.

name: Short Story → Business Lesson
description: Tell a tiny anecdote (often 1‑2 sentences) and end with a clear takeaway for the reader.
